visualFloor.policy: A downloadable visual successor must still pass the v25 scene-policy floor and retain v31-and-later shader-facing contracts. Nonvisual archival layers do not justify lowering that floor.

collision.status: source-closed substantially; full fresh-scene integration still required
requiredForLosslessExport: preserve terrain collision triangles and walkability bytes
preserve DynEnt live/destroyed XModel, FX and PhysPreset provenance
preserve MapEnts entity string and trigger arrays when present
provide an engine-friendly collision scene/sidecar without discarding T6-native metadata

lighting.status: partially source-closed; not yet complete as a live fresh-scene lighting reconstruction
sourceClosed: GfxSurface lightmapIndex ownership and dedicated lightmap UVs
reflection probe resource ownership and universal reflection vector/decode mechanics
stillOpen: compile/run corrected retail GfxWorld lightmap catalog dumper against the pinned map
compile/run corrected retail reflection-probe catalog dumper and archive exact cubemap payloads
promote remaining 65 reflection fetches only after pinned-corpus closure
apply all exact lighting state in the actual downloadable fresh full-map scene rather than merely archiving dependencies

otherFullMapLayersRequired: 2992 serialized static placements with canonical scene-role filtering
exact static/world materials and texture payloads
animation/support scenes and skins retained by the current full-map floor
DynEnt definitions and exact asset provenance
GameWorld/ComWorld data needed for gameplay/path/light ownership
FX/audio/scripts/other XAssets as separate export domains when the goal is every retail asset, rather than forcing all of them into one GLB
promotionPolicy: There are two separate gates: visual-successor gate (v25/v31 non-regression) and lossless-full-asset gate (this manifest). A scene may pass the visual gate while still lacking nonvisual collision/gameplay/light metadata. Do not call the project an all-assets extraction until both categories are satisfied or remaining unsupported domains are explicitly enumerated.
